newsitem.title: CHINA: China '96 chemical output seen at 252 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China '96 chemical output seen at 252 bln yuan.

text.p: Production by China's chemical industry is expected to hit 252 billion yuan ($30.4 billion) in 1996, up 9.7 percent from last year, the China News Service said on Tuesday.
Total output for the chemical sector in the first 11 months of 1996 was nearly 232 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of about 11 percent, state media said earlier this month.

Production of chemical fertilisers would reach a record 123 million tonnes in 1996, exceeding the state-set target by 8.4 percent, the China News Service quoted industry officials as saying. It gave no comparative figures.
Pesticide output would hit 350,000 tonnes, up 23 percent compared with last year, it said without giving further details.
